svg.title: Speed filter: smoother means later
svg.desc: Animated. A graph of speed against time: the true speed ramps up and levels off. A shaded block of eight 32 ms windows slides along the time axis, and the SPARK's reading, the average of what is inside the block, is drawn at its leading edge. The reading traces the same ramp about 128 ms later, half the time it averages over, and levels off late too. A NEO on a SPARK MAX by default averages 8 windows of 32 ms end to end. Smoother means later: about half the time it averages over. A loop that reads a late speed must push gently, or it reacts to old news. Shorter windows are less late but jump more: the tool suggests 16 ms, depth 1 (8 ms late).
svg.text: A NEO on a SPARK MAX by default: 8 windows of 32 ms, averaged end to end.
the SPARK's reading: the average of the shaded windows
Smoother means later: about half the time it averages over.
A loop that reads a late speed must push gently, or it reacts to old news.
Shorter windows are less late but jump more: the tool suggests 16 ms, depth 1 (8 ms late).
